subject: FW: FleetWave renewal — request for sustainment package / senior authorization
messages:
From: Sarah Chong <sarah@fleetwave.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: support@fleetwave.com
Date: 2028-05-09 09:12 -0700
Subject: Renewal questions and service concerns

Naomi, thanks for the renewal notice — we got the renewal packet last week. Two quick things:

1) Our usage spiked through Q1 and costs are higher than anticipated; we need a path to keep the product in place without a 40%+ uplift this renewal cycle.
2) We experienced two production incidents in March that impacted latency for key endpoints. Operations is asking for an SLA add-on for 12 months to reduce business risk.

Can you propose something that keeps FleetWave on Redwood while addressing cost and reliability? We are evaluating a competing provider who quoted deeper first-year discounts.

Thanks,
Sarah Chong
Director of Product
FleetWave

--
Attachment: fleetwave_q1_2028_usage_report.csv

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chong <sarah@fleetwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-09 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal questions and service concerns

Sarah — appreciate the candidness and the usage data. Short answer: we want to keep FleetWave as a strategic customer. Long answer: I can put together a sustainment package but will need senior sign-off for non-standard economics. 

Prelim proposal (subject to approval):
- 20% first-year discount on list for the renewal term (12 months)
- $40,000 one-time credit to offset Q1 overage charges
- Add a 12-month SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9%% availability for core inference endpoints with an operational playbook and monthly performance reports
- 30-day notice to evaluate year-2 list pricing (no auto-rollback)

If we can get authorization for the above (or acceptably close), I will: 1) push a formal amendment, 2) offer a short-term price-protection window while they sign, and 3) coordinate a technical postmortem and runbook handoff with Support.

I'm escalating this for senior authorization due to the combined credit + SLA commitment. Looping in marissa and david for approval and karthik/ben for pricing and contract language.

Best,
Naomi
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: proposed_sustainment_amendment_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10 08:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FleetWave renewal — senior authorization request

Team — forwarding Naomi's ask. Fast summary and ask for decision:

Why FleetWave matters: they are a mid-enterprise customer using Redwood for real-time routing across their fleet analytics stack. ARR at risk ~ $1.05M. The competitor is pushing aggressive first-year pricing to win.

Naomi's proposed concessions (requested):
- 20%% first-year discount
- $40k one-time credit to make Q1 whole
- 12-month SLA addendum (99.9%% for inference endpoints)

Finance view (Ben): we could absorb up to $30k credit if we can extend the contract to 18 months and include a committed usage floor; otherwise impact to margin is material.
Karthik, please advise on contract language and any precedent for SLA addenda (especially the measurement and remedy clauses).

Decision requested: approval to offer the package as-is, or an alternative authorization (eg 15%% + $30k + conditional SLA). Need a response by EOD 5/11 — customer expects a counter before their procurement review next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-12 15:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: FleetWave renewal — senior authorization request

Thanks for the summary. Reviewed the numbers and the strategic context. Decision: authorize a targeted sustainment package with conditions.

Approved concession (final):
- 18%% first-year discount on the renewal invoice (applies to subscription only)
- $35,000 one-time credit to compensate Q1 overages (to be applied after invoicing and documented in the amendment)
- 12-month SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9%% availability for core inference endpoints. SLA remedies capped (standard playbook): service credits not to exceed one monthly invoice in any 12-month period.

Conditions:
1) Customer must sign the amendment within 14 days of receiving the DocuSign link.
2) Extend the committed term to 18 months total (renewal term + 6-month commitment) to make the economics acceptable.
3) Require a usage commitment floor (70%% of current Q2 projected usage) or step-down pricing after the first 6 months if usage drops below the floor.

Karthik — please produce the amendment with the SLA language and get Finance (Ben) to confirm accounting treatment. Naomi — you have authorization to submit the amended offer and open a 14-day sign window. I want the docusign and hubspot update completed by EOD 5/13.

-David
David Kim
VP Sales — Americas
Redwood Inference

--
